grading: Correct only if every requested material fact resolved, no contradiction or unsupported guess. Partial for missing/unresolved parts, incorrect for any material contradiction. Judge content rather than support label.

answers.answer: The simultaneous addition destroys one Presence from each Spirit, even though two Blight tokens are added. Two separate additions destroy one Presence per Spirit on each addition, hence two per Spirit if available. Cascades elsewhere are outside the requested count.

Concealing Shadows does not prevent them: its protection is only against Damage from Ravaging Invaders, while Poisoned Land explicitly Destroys Dahan. Infinite Vitality's threshold makes those Dahan ignore Damage and Destruction effects, so it prevents that destruction.
source_refs: Primary original card faces: Concealing Shadows, Poisoned Land, Infinite Vitality in card-scope-source/

answers.answer: Direct Spirit Power Damage is not reduced by Defend, so those Dahan take 2 Damage in the Defend-only case. Concealing Shadows also does not prevent it because it only protects from Ravaging Invaders. Infinite Vitality’s threshold does prevent that Damage. In the separate Invader Ravage case, Defend 3 reduces 2 to zero for both land and Dahan, not negative Damage.

The grant stays +2; Range boosts do not increase another Range boost. Reaching Grasp’s Power-only bonus applies to B’s Powers, including Innates and Power Cards, subject to the normal Range-arrow restrictions. It does not extend ordinary Growth, which is not a Power; Power Cards also resolve after normal Growth.
source_refs: Primary original Reaching Grasp face: card-scope-source/reaching_grasp.jpg

answers.answer: For a land-targeting Power, measure the internal arrow from the target land unless otherwise specified. For a Spirit-targeting Power, normally measure from the Presence of the Spirit following the instruction, B here, unless the text says otherwise. Apply the bonuses of the Power user A, not B: the stated Range 1 becomes Range 3 from B’s Presence. Blazing Renewal explicitly measures from the Power user A’s Presence, even when B adds Presence; its explicit origin overrides the default.

Its printed Elements remain while the card is in play and can support Innates even though its text was not used. The paid Energy is not refunded. Foregoing the text does not remove/discard the card immediately; it stays in play and is normally discarded during Time Passes, when its Elements go away.
source_refs: CORE p.17 General Principle You Can Skip Using A Power’s Effect; pp.8,10,16

answers.answer: Defend is not expended: it reduces each Ravage by 3 for the entire turn. Each deals 1 Damage to land and 1 to Dahan. Land Damage below 2 is ignored per occurrence, so the two 1-Damage land results never combine into Blight. The Dahan’s first 1 Damage persists until Time Passes; the second 1 reaches its 2 Health and destroys it before a second counterattack.

Yes to both. The Spirit may resolve the first Power as if it had fewer Elements, consistently for that entire Power, and must resolve the base effect plus all thresholds met by that assumed set. The hypothetical reduction does not spend or remove actual Elements, so another Power may still use the actual 3 Water. It is not permission to select or skip individual threshold instructions independently.

It must choose one entire Growth option and perform all possible actions in that option. It may not combine actions from separate options or select multiple options without an explicit instruction permitting that. The actions within the chosen option may be performed in any order.
source_refs: CORE p.8 Spirit Phase, Grow step: Choose one option; Each section is a single choice

answers.answer: Both A and B are legal targets. Printed Range 1 is a maximum, so Range 0 is allowed: A contains your Presence and B is one land away. The Power does not have to target a land exactly one away.
source_refs: CORE p.16 Anatomy of Powers, Range: This is a maximum; you can always use a shorter Range

answers.answer: Yes. Powerstorm grants the Spirit a general once-this-turn Repeat option, not a permission restricted to cards already in play at grant time. The new Major is eligible once it is in play; Bringer can pay its cost and Repeat it at its current Speed. Forgetting Call on Midnight’s Dream does not remove the separate new Major.
source_refs: Primary original Powerstorm and Call on Midnight’s Dream faces in card-scope-source/

answers.answer: No. There is no default stacking limit for any piece, so crowding alone cannot prevent those otherwise legal additions or movements. Each specific action must still obey its normal instructions. A large Presence stack still forms only one Sacred Site for that Spirit in that land.
source_refs: CORE p.13 Presence; default no per-land limits

answers.answer: The option must be chosen before either option begins resolving. Bringer cannot inspect the Major Power draw and then switch to the 2 Fear option. If the Major-gain option is chosen, resolve that option, including the ordinary draw-four/keep-one and Major Forgetting requirement; drawing the cards is already resolving that option.
source_refs: Primary original Call on Midnight’s Dream face in card-scope-source/

answers.answer: The Spirit must complete Growth, then gain normal Energy, then play and pay for Power Cards. It may not take the normal income or actually play/pay cards before Growth. The normal income step follows Growth and uses the highest number then uncovered, including a higher number just revealed by that Growth, so the benefit applies in this same Spirit Phase. Players may plan their choices earlier; planning is not the formal play/pay step.

It may reposition an existing island Presence instead of taking a track disk even while track disks remain. Empty tracks are not a prerequisite. Choose a normally legal destination using existing Presence, then take an own island disk; this does not uncover a new track benefit.
The normal Power adds Defend 1, not 2: its printed Fear counts but ordinary Town-destruction Fear does not. The 2 Fear from To Dream a Thousand Deaths does count and adds Defend 2.
source_refs: effect text and parenthetical Fear-source exception

answers.answer: Yes. The Spirit using Tidal Boon (Ocean) may move that Dahan to any Coastal land instead of Drowning it; the destination need not be adjacent. This is optional. If the option is not taken, the ordinary Ocean Drowning applies. It applies to this Power’s Push, not later unrelated Pushes.

Wrap’s explicit First instruction Gathers before the base Move, allowing those gathered Dahan to be moved by the base effect and Defend 5 in the destination if at least one moves. Dissolve’s explicit Before Pushing instruction resolves its threshold Damage before the Explorer Push (after the preceding replacements). Such timing words override the default top-to-bottom position; they do not create another Power use.
source_refs: threshold First instruction and base Move/Defend

answers.answer: Spirit Phase, Fast Power Phase, Invader Phase, Slow Power Phase, Time Passes. All Spirits must finish the Spirit Phase before anyone resolves Fast Powers. Within the phase, players may choose Power order, completing one before the next.
